**Install:** download the `.dmg` below, open it and drag **Lucid** to **Applications** (Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or newer). Lucid is not notarized by Apple, so macOS asks once: on macOS 15 open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**; on macOS 13 and 14 right-click the app and choose **Open**. Then start [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai) with the model `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`. Details are in the [README](https://github.com/triggeredcode/lucid#install).

Check a download with `shasum -a 256 --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS`.
